-Starchy / Floury

-Varný Typ C		 High in starch, low in moisture, cook fast, fall apart easily. Thick rough skin. Frying, baking, mashed Russets, most sweet potatoes, Jewel Yam, Japanese Sweet
-Waxy

-Varný Typ A		 Lower starch, higher moisture, smaller, hold together. Shiny waxy thin skin. Roasting, boiling, salads Fingerlings, Red Bliss, French Fingerling, Russian Banana
